title: Multicopy suppressor screen
protocol: Select suppressor mutants from the 31019b yeast strain carrying the high copy number plasmid pDR-AtAMT1;1Thr460Ala by growing at 28°C for 8 days on solid YNB medium supplemented with 3% glucose and 2 mM ammonium chloride.
Pick suppressors and amplify in liquid YNB medium supplemented with 3% glucose and 2 mM ammonium.
Isolate plasmid from yeast by CTAB extraction.
Use isolated plasmids for E. coli transformation.
